arch: small modules with one job - keep the require graph shallow
dependency injection via function args - test without mocks
event emitters for cross-cutting flows - avoid god objects
pure core with adapters at edges - test without mocks
description: Write modern JavaScript (ESM, async await) with eslint-clean style. Use for Node or browser JS code and reviews.
idioms: const by default, ESM import export everywhere
optional chaining and nullish coalescing for safe access
URL and Intl APIs over hand-rolled parsing
name: javascript-code
pitfalls: unhandled promise rejections - handle every chain
mutating shared state - copy on write
hand-rolled date math - use a library
style: ESM only in new code, type module or .mjs
triple-equals always; no with, no var
eslint recommended plus prettier, zero warnings
JSDoc on exported functions when no types
top-level await only in scripts, not libraries
testing: vitest or node:test; fake timers for time; no real network in units.
triggers: setting up Node builds, lint, or tests
